name: p9-mom-volman
description: P9 cell P9-M (lane AL-COMB, task-AL-COMB-report.md; plan DEC-16: after the Y-2 read; registration scripts/specs/p9/rules/mom-volman-v1.json, every constant fixed blind before any read): composition schedule mom-volman-v1. Hypothesis (Barroso and Santa-Clara 2015, JFE 116(1), 1927:03-2011:12: scaling WML by its six-month realised volatility lifts its Sharpe .53 -> .97; Daniel and Moskowitz 2016, JFE 122(2); real-time form Cederburg, O'Doherty, Wang and Yan 2020, JFE 138(1), sample to 2016:12: volatility management fails in real time for about half of 103 strategies, and momentum is among the exceptions; lit section 1.6 [16]-[19]): momentum's own realised volatility forecasts its next-month volatility but not its mean. Only the price_momentum theme's mass moves; Y-1 (book volatility) and theme-tsmom-v1 (every theme's trailing sign) are other objects (lit section 7 restatement risk; the PM rules distinctness before any read). Rule (strategy_ic_mom_volman.cpp; the fitter only records the sleeve, composition_mom_volman.py): sleeve r(d) = the price_momentum theme's sleeve over the parent fit's role decisions as theme-tsmom-v1's step 1 forms it (sum over its members of (w_k / W_t) s_k f_k(d), f formed at d and realised at d + 2); block b starts at decision j_b = 127 + 21 b; sigma_b = sqrt(mean of r(d)^2 over the 126 decisions ending j_b - 2); target_b = the running mean of sigma_0 .. sigma_b (Cederburg's real-time constant, no full-sample constant); the block's masses are the parent's W_t except W_price_momentum x target_b / sigma_b; before the first block the parent's masses; no cap. The IC runner applies the masses through the theme schedule theme-tsmom-v1 uses (theme_schedule block, rule mom-volman-v1; the two schedules exclude each other). The change comes only from the atx.research-wave/v2 manifest's rules block [{name: mom-volman-v1, params: {}}] (Ruling ALCOMB-1; the fitter flag --mom-volman mom-volman-v1 is derived from the IC exe's rule table through wave_kinds.COMPOSITION_FLAGS, never from this template); the parent's fit must be --composition ew-theme-std-v1 or --composition ic-shrink-v1, with or without --theme-erc theme-erc-v1 (the parents the fitter's --mom-volman accepts, composition_mom_volman.PARENT_RULES), weight price_momentum, and carry neither theme-tsmom-v1 nor theme-resid-v1 (the fitter and the IC exe refuse both); the fit runs without --engine-fit (refused with --mom-volman: the C++ composition fit records no momentum sleeve). Downstream outputs renamed (fit, card, w, nav, monitor); the u pass is the parent's. Gross matching (PM6-6) binds the cell (plan section 5.2): the schedule changes the momentum mass, so the cell is judged at the parent's dollar gross through C2's calibration. Acceptance (PM7-34 default): paired S2 net dSR > 0 against the parent AND mechanics. Printed, deciding nothing: per block of the recorded sleeve its realised volatility sigma_b (before scaling), the target_b it is scaled to and the scale_b (the IC exe's summary.json, each scored role's composition_schedule_trace), turnover per unit gross, net Sharpe at 4x NAV. Conditional on lane D3 (Ruling ALCOMB-6): the sleeve's realised volatility and Sharpe before and after scaling (plan section 5.2 P9-M) are printed only if D3 has made the IC exe write the momentum sleeve's daily series before and after scaling and atx-research-eval prints them from those files (no Python derivation); PRE round 2 cuts this sentence before registration if D3 has not delivered it. Identity before the cell: the parent's w argv re-run on the new build is byte-identical (no theme_schedule block); MomVolman.SharedParseAndRefusals keeps theme-tsmom-v1's parse and refusals.
requires: the PM has read Y-2 (theme-tsmom-v1) and ruled mom-volman-v1 distinct from Y-2 and Y-1 before any P9-M read (plan DEC-16, lit section 7 restatement risk, E-45 / PM7-14)
